judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the planning and failing-test phase: it added `.lore/dod.md`, updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and created a new acceptance test file `src/orchestration/usageAggregation.acceptance.test.ts`, but never modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the production code in `chatOrchestrator.ts` is completely untouched, the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately on `npm test`. Furthermore, the candidate missed updating `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and the hook parameter signature (`totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`). While the spec update in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the acceptance test scenarios themselves are well-constructed, the absence of the actual implementation makes the submission broken and incomplete.
